inputs.prompt: Same Claude as <Picture 1>: orange hair, amber eyes, ivory lace veil, orange flower, white dress with orange embroidery and black ribbon, correct gentle adult anime face. Keep the exact upright body posture, lowered shoulders, gently bent elbows and wrists held by short chains under the wooden crossbeam. Her back remains against the central post, her body weight supported by her feet on a hidden ledge. Detailed Japanese gothic 2D anime with fine linework, layered cel shading and painted cathedral architecture. Cool blue stained glass and warm amber candle rim light, preserving copper-orange hair. No 3D doll look, no exaggerated grimace, no distorted joints, no captions, no cuts. Medium close-up framing from the chest up, camera level, face clearly readable. This is the moment AFTER a violet magic torch has ignited the wood below frame. Restrained deep violet flames flicker along the bottom foreground only, below her chest, with a little smoke drifting beside her, never covering her face. Purple light subtly joins the existing warm candlelight, her hair stays COPPER ORANGE, not pink. Claude looks down toward the rising heat, breath catches, lips part in a small frightened gasp, then she lifts her gaze slightly toward the offscreen child with quiet frightened resolve. Keep expression restrained and vulnerable, no grotesque open-mouth scream or bared teeth, no smile. Her upright body barely moves, no torso twisting or head thrown back. The cuffs and cross remain fixed. Non-graphic danger, no visible injury, no burns, no damaged clothing. One continuous fixed shot.
